title: Element Materialization Audit — From Strong Definitions to Real-World Instrumentation
purpose: Audit high-value Potato House elements against the crystallization gate and identify where the project already has strong definitions but still lacks enough real-world population, longitudinal change, scale, visibility and correction data to make those elements analytically useful.
audit_rule: Do not reward another symbolic definition when a canonical element already exists. Prefer adding real entities, dated observations, relationships, outcome measures, counterexamples, correction paths and failure conditions to the strongest existing owner.

findings.evidence: 41 deep element definitions plus typed layer/terrain/regime distinctions already define identity, function, topology, neighbors, distinctions, failure modes and tests.
findings.missing: Many operators still have fewer longitudinal real-world cases than conceptual crosswalks.
findings.action: Do not add another operator family. Exercise existing operators against entities and processes.

findings.evidence: Nine reproduction mechanisms and cross-domain Foundation records already exist.
findings.missing: More observed succession, amendment, training, interoperability, branching and failure histories across the same entities over time.
findings.action: Attach Foundation/reproduction observations to real entity dossiers and longitudinal cases.

findings.evidence: Each element already has operational tests, failure modes and connections.
findings.missing: Repeated cases measuring capability growth, correction, exit, externalities, pruning and future Seed.
findings.action: Use entity and programme dossiers to supply measurable cases instead of adding more abstract prose.

findings.current_strength: high first-case quality / low sample and time depth
findings.evidence: Four source-grounded dossiers already separate identity, Spirit/Mind/Body, relationships, operators, Fruit, Shadow and open questions.
findings.missing: Scale is implicit; visibility/access is mixed into Shadow; reproduction/correction is scattered; longitudinal observations are not first-class.
findings.action: Promote scale, reproduction/correction, visibility/access and longitudinal indicators into the dossier contract and backfill wave 001.

findings.evidence: Entity cases render Spirit/Mind/Body, operators, Shadow and discovery questions.
findings.missing: The reader cannot yet see scale, observed change, reproduction/correction or visibility boundaries even when the data exists.
findings.action: Expose those dimensions in the entity-case panel with progressive disclosure rather than another page.

first_implementation_wave.why: It simultaneously deepens Foundation, Garden, Repair, Fruit, Tree, Spirit/Mind/Body, World Systems and the House without inventing a new ontology.
entities: International Committee of the Red Cross
first_implementation_wave.result: Wave 001 now exposes scale, dependencies, reproduction/correction, visibility/access and source-backed longitudinal indicators for Danmarks Nationalbank, Wikimedia Foundation, CERN and ICRC; House renders these dimensions and CI validates the contract.

build Garden→Repair cases with before/after measures
add longitudinal Foundation/reproduction histories to additional institutions and protocols
